subject: Eval integration scope for Route-level A/B testing v1 (offline suites only)
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 22, 2026 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Eval integration scope for Route-level A/B testing v1 (offline suites only)

Marissa / Dylan,

Wanted to explicitly align on eval integration scope for the route-level A/B testing v1 so we don’t overcommit during Beta.

Proposed v1 scope (Beta + initial GA):
1) Offline eval suite attachment to an experiment
- In Console: “Attach eval suite” (select from existing suites/prompt sets)
- Runs are initiated manually (or scheduled nightly) against pinned model/config for Variant A vs Variant B
- Results are stored as an artifact that the Console reads

2) Summary quality deltas in Console
- Show per-suite rollup: overall score delta (B vs A), plus key sub-metrics we already compute in the harness
- Confidence indicators: keep it simple for v1 (e.g., CI bands + sample size + “insufficient data” states). Sana has guidance here.
- Link-out to raw eval report in the harness for power users

3) Guardrails / messaging
- Make it clear in the UI that these are offline measurements, not live production quality.
- No automated decisioning (no “promote variant” button based on evals).

Out of scope for v1 (defer):
A) Online judge / sampled production scoring
- No LLM-judge/human-judge sampling on live traffic in Beta
- No pipeline that samples request/response pairs for later scoring

B) Custom customer metrics ingestion
- Stick to standardized hooks (latency/cost/errors/exposures + offline eval suite results)

Why defer online judge sampling:
- Privacy + retention constraints are not nailed down yet for capturing prompt/response content (even sampled)
- Operational risk: easy to accidentally increase cardinality / storage and complicate security review
- Timeline: we’re already tight on getting deterministic assignment + exposure logging + results dashboard into a coherent Beta

Dependencies / assumptions (for v1 offline suite integration):
- We only need experiment_id + variant labels + model/config references in control-plane to run evals reproducibly
- No dependency on exposure logs for offline evals (though we’ll use exposures for adoption + traffic volume context)

If you’re aligned, I’ll update ENG-2846 notes + the Confluence design doc with this explicit scope boundary, and we can reflect it in the Beta release notes.

Thanks,
Jonas

—
Jonas Weber
Evals / Quality Measurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Eval integration scope for Route-level A/B testing v1 (offline suites only)

+1 to this scope.

Two asks:
- Can we make sure the Console copy clearly differentiates “offline eval suite results” vs “production metrics” (we had confusion during rollouts GA)?
- For v1, can the “Attach suite” flow require selecting an existing suite only (no create/edit suite inline)?

If you can bake those into the doc + ENG-2846 acceptance criteria, I’m comfortable calling this locked for Beta.

Marissa


On Sun, Feb 22, 2026 at 10:18 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 22, 2026 at 10:18 AM
Subject: Re: Eval integration scope for Route-level A/B testing v1 (offline suites only)

Aligned.

From an implementation standpoint, deferring online judge sampling removes a bunch of questions around:
- where the data lands (telemetry pipeline vs eval harness)
- who can access it
- retention and deletions

Let’s keep v1 to: attach existing suite + show summary deltas.

One thing to confirm: are we OK with the harness running evals against BOTH variants using the same prompt set snapshot (i.e., freezing prompts at run time)? That makes results more reproducible.

Dylan


From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 23, 2026 at 10:03 AM
Subject: Re: Eval integration scope for Route-level A/B testing v1 (offline suites only)

Yes — for v1 we’ll snapshot/freeze the suite definition (prompt set + scoring config) at run time and persist it with the run artifact. That gives us replayability and avoids “suite drift” changing historical results.

Action items (I’ll take these):
- Update Confluence doc to explicitly call out “offline-only” and defer online sampling
- Update ENG-2846 acceptance criteria: attach existing suite only (no inline suite editing), UI copy separation, snapshot behavior
- Add a note in PM-481 / Beta release notes: online judge sampling not included in Beta

Jonas
